task: Create a multivariate flag named "price_alerts_copy" whose control value is "Buy now", with two variations "Get it today" and "Add to bag". Each variation must get 50% of users in every environment. Leave the flag enabled.
finalText: DONE: Created multivariate flag `price_alerts_copy` (feature id 788) with control value "Buy now", variations "Get it today" and "Add to bag" at 50% each, enabled. Verified in both Development and Production: enabled, with the same variants and weights.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith feature create --help; flagsmith feature update --help 2>&1 | head -60; flagsmith config

flagsmith feature variant --help; flagsmith feature variant add --help 2>&1 | head -40; flagsmith feature list --json | jq -r '.[]?.name // .' 2>/dev/null | head -50; flagsmith feature list 2>&1 | head -50

flagsmith feature create price_alerts_copy --value "Buy now" --enabled --variants '[{"value":"Get it today","weight":50},{"value":"Add to bag","weight":50}]' 2>&1; echo "---"; flagsmith feature get price_alerts_copy 2>&1; echo "---"; flagsmith feature variant list price_alerts_copy 2>&1

flagsmith flag --help | head -20; for k in MeoRNnzr7nLE7iwNyqxe5F bkPMBe8ApwQBuS4bgrd9wD; do echo "== $k"; flagsmith flag list -e $k 2>&1 | grep -i -A0 price_alerts; flagsmith feature get price_alerts_copy -e $k 2>&1; done
